hypothesis: A balanced cross-entropy choice objective from pairs of separately actually selected factual return consequences may teach raw neural, explicit-gate neural and native+recurrent models to condition return decisions on an informative fifth observation; a fifth-effect-erased model must fail the sign-dependent decision test.

data.paired_label: lower actual squared-goal cost of two independently selected factual FIT return trajectories with identical preaction history, one return_action=0, other=1; no unchosen evaluator return
data.score_B_stream: Independent deterministic harmonic nuisance, score group salts 21050000 DEV and 21060000 OOD; not a source of hidden q or sign

arms.raw_model: R35 existing 48D raw P80 fifth action, actual fifth effect, candidate return action -> 64D GELU -> 64D GELU -> score
arms.explicit_model: R35 raw 48D plus three public-only causal-gate features: fifth matches public context, return matches public context, joint match; no q/sign/known physics/hidden outcome
arms.native_model: R34 native factual-history+native backbone+learned recurrent 32D readout, exactly original raw action/effect P80
arms.history_only_model: R34 history-only recurrent model, native backbone absent
arms.erased_model: R35 raw network identical to raw arm but all fifth factual effect tensors zeroed in both FIT training and score
arms.readout_score: lower logit is predicted preferred factual return

train.optimizer: AdamW learning rate .002 raw/explicit/erased and .001 native/history, weight_decay .01, clip_grad_norm 1
train.objective: balanced categorical cross entropy over two cost logits generated from actually separately selected factual return actions; target=argmin(actual return cost0, actual return cost1)
train.comparison_alignment: same pair batches and initial seeds, 512 updates, sample budget all arms; raw/explicit capacity differs 3 input features; native/history capacity not matched
train.fit_holdout_validation: compare predicted preference with fully factual held-out selected return pair labels after 128,256,512 updates; no heldout samples used for weight optimization
train.gradient_negative: abort on zero/nonfinite gradient and any unmasked last effect influence
